plugins/presencium/desktop/modal/regle.e.La règle patiente ce nombre de minutes,: The rule waits this many minutes, then acts — unless the trigger reverses in the meantime: someone comes home during the delay, and the departure is canceled. This is the safeguard that keeps the alarm from arming on a trip to the mailbox. Zero to act right away.

plugins/presencium/desktop/modal/regle.e.Le moment qui déclenche la règle. « Le p: The moment that fires the rule. “The first one arrives” and “The last one leaves” only happen when the house goes from empty to occupied and back, whereas “Someone arrives” applies to every person. plugins/presencium/desktop/modal/regle.e.Les déclenchements écartés pour cause de: Triggers turned away by the cooldown appear in the log; they do not vanish in silence.
plugins/presencium/desktop/modal/regle.e.Les jours où la règle peut se déclencher: The days on which the rule may fire. Unticking them all is the same as ticking them all: a rule with no day chosen is not a restricted rule, it is a rule that applies every day. To suspend a rule, untick “Active”.
plugins/presencium/desktop/modal/regle.e.Limite la règle à une tranche de la jour: Limits the rule to a slice of the day. A range that crosses midnight — from 22:00 to 06:00 — is accepted as is.
plugins/presencium/desktop/modal/regle.e.Pour « Quelqu'un arrive » et « Quelqu'un: For “Someone arrives” and “Someone leaves”: the person concerned, or anyone. The other triggers cover the whole household and ignore this field.
plugins/presencium/desktop/modal/regle.e.Toutes les conditions doivent être vraie: Every condition must be true at the moment the rule fires, otherwise the rule is turned away — and the log says which one blocked it. With no condition at all, the rule always fires.
plugins/presencium/desktop/modal/regle.e.Une fois partie, la règle ne peut plus r: Once it has fired, the rule cannot fire again before this delay. This is the anti-repeat guard: a detector that wavers will not send ten notifications in ten minutes. Zero to allow every trigger.
plugins/presencium/desktop/modal/regle.e.« Tester » joue la règle maintenant, con: “Test” runs the rule right now, conditions included, on the saved version of the household: save first if you have just changed it. Outside simulation mode, the test really sends the commands.

plugins/presencium/desktop/php/presenciu.Baisser ce délai rend les départs plus r: Lowering this delay makes departures quicker and false departures more frequent: that is an alarm arming on someone sitting in their own living room.
plugins/presencium/desktop/php/presenciu.C'est le réglage qui sépare le rebond d': This is the setting that separates a tag bounce from a real departure: the plugin only declares the person absent if the signal stays absent for this whole delay, and a return in the meantime produces no departure at all. 15 minutes is the value measured on real Tile tags, whose false absences run from 2 seconds to 13 minutes, while the real ones last more than an hour.
plugins/presencium/desktop/php/presenciu.Ces commandes sont créées et tenues à jo: These commands are created and kept up to date by the plugin: they come back on every save, so deleting them is pointless. You can, however, rename them and change their visibility — those choices are honored.

plugins/presencium/desktop/php/presenciu.Cochez les habitants de ce foyer : sans: Tick this household's residents: without them, it stays empty permanently.
plugins/presencium/desktop/php/presenciu.Cochez les personnes qui habitent ce foy: Tick the people who live in this household. The occupancy, “who is home”, the first to arrive and the last to leave are all computed from them, and the arrival and departure rules only make sense on this list.
plugins/presencium/desktop/php/presenciu.Délai de confirmation d\\'un départ : le: Departure confirmation delay: the signal must stay absent for this long before the person is declared gone.
plugins/presencium/desktop/php/presenciu.En simulation, tout fonctionne sauf l'ex: In simulation mode, everything works except execution: people are tracked, rules evaluated, delays honored, and every decision is written to the log marked “simulated”. plugins/presencium/desktop/php/presenciu.Enfin, dans l\\'onglet « Règles » du foy: Finally, in the household's “Rules” tab, describe what should happen on an arrival or a departure. Leave simulation mode on for a few days: the log shows what would have fired, and why.

plugins/presencium/desktop/php/presenciu.L'asymétrie entre les deux délais est vo: The asymmetry between the two delays is deliberate: a departure is confirmed slowly, an arrival quickly.
plugins/presencium/desktop/php/presenciu.La commande info qui porte le signal bru: The info command that carries this person's raw signal: the Tile tag, the phone seen by the wifi, the car detector. It is the plugin's only input; everything else follows from it.
plugins/presencium/desktop/php/presenciu.La commande suivie doit être historisée,: The followed command must be historized, otherwise there is nothing to read back.
plugins/presencium/desktop/php/presenciu.La simulation globale est active dans la: Global simulation mode is on in the plugin configuration: this household is simulated even if this box is unticked.
plugins/presencium/desktop/php/presenciu.La simulation se règle à trois endroits,: Simulation mode is set in three places, and any one of them is enough for it to apply: the plugin configuration (everything), this household, or one particular rule. plugins/presencium/desktop/php/presenciu.La valeur que prend la commande quand la: The value the command takes when the person is home. “1” fits nearly every detector; some publish “on” or “present”, and the plugin accepts those too.
plugins/presencium/desktop/php/presenciu.Le journal garde ce que le plugin a déci: The log keeps what the plugin decided, and why: the rules that fired, those turned away by their conditions or by their schedule, and the presence movements — including the absorbed bounces, which show what your detector is really reporting.
plugins/presencium/desktop/php/presenciu.Le résultat est publié par la commande «: The result is published by the “Presence” command, and “Raw signal” keeps the detector's value as it is: comparing the two in the history shows exactly what the plugin absorbed.
plugins/presencium/desktop/php/presenciu.Les commandes que le plugin a reconnues: The commands the plugin recognized as presence commands in your installation. If yours is not among them, use the magnifier: it shows every info command.
plugins/presencium/desktop/php/presenciu.Les personnes sont suivies, les états pu: People are tracked, states published, rules evaluated and logged — but nothing is commanded, neither the actions of the rules nor the arming of the alarm. plugins/presencium/desktop/php/presenciu.Pour éprouver une règle sans sortir de c: To test a rule without leaving home. The override replaces the tag's signal until you hand control back to automatic tracking; it survives a restart.
plugins/presencium/desktop/php/presenciu.Relire les balises et rejouer les règles: Read the tags again and replay the rules right now, without waiting for the next minute
plugins/presencium/desktop/php/presenciu.Relit l'historique de la commande suivie: Reads back the followed command's history and replays the decision for several departure delays. The table says, on YOUR data, how many false departures each delay removes and how many real departures it lets through.
plugins/presencium/desktop/php/presenciu.Rien de configuré pour le moment. L\\'or: Nothing configured yet. The order matters:
plugins/presencium/desktop/php/presenciu.Rien n\\'est exécuté : les règles de ce: Nothing is executed: this household's rules are played dry and logged.
plugins/presencium/desktop/php/presenciu.Secondes de signal continu avant de décl: Seconds of continuous signal before declaring the arrival. Zero in almost every case: a missed arrival is a door that does not open and a light that does not come on. Only raise this value if your detector reports fleeting presences as it passes by the house.
plugins/presencium/desktop/php/presenciu.Simulation globale active : aucune actio: Global simulation mode is on: no action is executed.
plugins/presencium/desktop/php/presenciu.Sur un foyer : « Présence », « Tout le m: On a household: “Presence”, “Everyone is home”, “Occupancy” and “Who is home” belong on a dashboard; “Arm”, “Disarm” and enabling drive the alarm the plugin carries itself.
plugins/presencium/desktop/php/presenciu.Sur une personne : « Présence » est la p: On a person: “Presence” is the stabilized presence, “Raw signal” the detector's value, and the “Force” commands let you override it while you sort something out — “Automatic tracking” hands control back to the plugin.
plugins/presencium/desktop/php/presenciu.Tant qu'un forçage est actif, la balise: While an override is active, the tag has no say. The panel and the card say so.
plugins/presencium/desktop/php/presenciu.Tant que la simulation est active, elles: As long as simulation mode is on, they are evaluated and logged without executing anything: the “Log” tab says what would have happened.
plugins/presencium/desktop/php/presenciu.Un foyer sans personne reste vide en per: A household with no person stays empty for good: its departure rules would fire without anyone ever having left. Create one person per tag first, then tick them in the household.
plugins/presencium/desktop/php/presenciu.Une règle relie un moment — une arrivée,: A rule ties a moment — an arrival, a departure, a house empty for a while — to actions, under conditions. They are examined in the order of this list, every minute and on every presence change.
plugins/presencium/desktop/php/presenciu.Une semaine de campagne se relit dans un: A week of campaign reads better in a spreadsheet: you sort by verdict and count.
plugins/presencium/desktop/php/presenciu.Vos personnes sont suivies, mais aucun f: Your people are tracked, but no household brings them together: “someone is home”, “who is home” and the arrival and departure rules belong to the household. Click “Add a household” and tick your people in it.
plugins/presencium/desktop/php/presenciu.jours, une vraie absence dure au moins: days, a real absence lasts at least

plugins/presencium/plugin_info/configura.C'est ce délai qui sépare le rebond d'un: This is the delay that separates a tag bounce from a real departure: a person is only declared absent if their signal stays absent for this whole duration, and a return in the meantime produces none at all. 15 minutes is the value measured on real Tile tags, whose false absences run from 2 seconds to 13 minutes, while the real ones last more than an hour.
plugins/presencium/plugin_info/configura.De 10 à 5000 entrées : au-delà de ces bo: From 10 to 5000 entries: beyond these bounds, the plugin applies the nearest one without saying so. The log also keeps the presence movements, including the absorbed bounces: that is where the false positives of your detectors can be read.
plugins/presencium/plugin_info/configura.En minutes, 0 pour ne rien contrôler. Le: In minutes, 0 to check nothing. The plugin never flips presence on its own for this reason: declaring absent someone you have no news from would arm the alarm on a person sitting in their living room. It reports it, you decide.
plugins/presencium/plugin_info/configura.Force la simulation sur tous les foyers: Forces simulation mode on every household and every rule, whatever their own settings. Presences are tracked, states published, rules evaluated and their decisions written to the log — but no action is sent, and the alarm is neither armed nor enabled. This is the way to try out a whole installation without risking anything.
plugins/presencium/plugin_info/configura.La simulation globale est active : le pl: Global simulation mode is on: the plugin executes no action.
plugins/presencium/plugin_info/configura.Ne le montez que si votre détecteur sign: Only raise it if your detector reports fleeting presences — a phone that catches the wifi as it passes by the house.
plugins/presencium/plugin_info/configura.Nombre d'entrées gardées par foyer. Le j: Number of entries kept per household. The log is a file that does not grow: past this limit, the oldest entries disappear. 200 comfortably covers several days; raise the value for a long simulation campaign.
plugins/presencium/plugin_info/configura.Proposé aux personnes nouvellement créée: Offered to newly created people. Each person then keeps their own: changing this value does not touch those that already exist.
plugins/presencium/plugin_info/configura.Secondes de signal continu avant de décl: Seconds of continuous signal before declaring an arrival. Zero in almost every case: a missed arrival is a door that does not open. The asymmetry with the departure delay is deliberate — a departure is confirmed slowly, an arrival quickly.
plugins/presencium/plugin_info/configura.Tout le reste continue — présences suivi: Everything else carries on — presences tracked, rules evaluated, log kept — but nothing is commanded anywhere, in any household.
plugins/presencium/plugin_info/configura.Une balise qui se dit présente mais n'ém: A tag that claims to be present but has not emitted for this long is flagged on the Health page. It happens when a battery dies while the person is home: presence freezes on “present” and the house never becomes empty again.
plugins/presencium/plugin_info/configura.À laisser cochée les premiers jours : on: Best left ticked for the first few days: you then read each household's log, see what would have fired and why, and untick it once nothing surprises you any more. Simulation mode is also set household by household and rule by rule; any one of the three is enough for it to apply.
